messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Natalie Baird <natalie.baird@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: XFN action scrub + QBR risk thermometer

Team — following today's cross-functional sync I pulled together a lightweight action scrub and a one-page risk thermometer for the QBR. Attached: xfn_action_tracker.xlsx (sheet per owner) and qbr_risk_thermometer.pdf.

Top asks / exec asks (short):
- Exec ask A: decide whether we accept a 2-week soft exception on the Dedicated autoscaler change (impact: 20% throughput variance). Need Lauren sign-off by EOD Friday.
- Exec ask B: prioritize quantization profile for rtx-variants — cost delta estimate needed by Monday. Owner: Marissa.
- Exec ask C: commit to fallback model routing for EU customers (comms + QA window) — owner: Karthik.

Please do the following by Thursday COB: update your row in the tracker, set a Risk Level (High/Medium/Low), list blockers, and if you need an SLA exception mark the cell. I'll consolidate for the QBR readout and annotate any open exec decisions.

Notes: Natalie from Acme is looped for visibility on the autoscaler exception request (they're already on a pilot that would see the throughput variance). Satori integrations is on the thread for the routing dependency.

Quick timelines: tracker updates due Thu 5/14 17:00 PT; Lauren decision desired by Fri 5/15 17:00 PT.

Thanks —
Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: XFN action scrub + QBR risk thermometer

Thanks Sean — I updated the tracker (Row 7/quantization) with a first-pass cost delta (estimated token cost change ~+12% for rtx-8bit vs rtx-16bit) and noted that we need ML infra time to run a final profile sweep.

Quick detail:
- Blocker: we need 48 GPU-hours on the internal benchmark cluster (request submitted to infra).
- Mitigation: if we can't get the compute window this week we'll run a prioritized sweep for top-10 workload prompts and present conservative estimates for the QBR.

Attachment: updated xfn_action_tracker.xlsx (I updated the "Quantization" tab).

Marissa
Principal PM, Model Ops
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Natalie Baird <natalie.baird@acmehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: XFN action scrub + QBR risk thermometer

Looping back on the routing fallback ask — during the sync we surfaced a dependency: cloud infra is changing the per-region endpoint mapping (autoscaling and IP migration) which impacts our ability to guarantee consistent fallbacks for EU.

Consequence: without the autoscaler change we can implement fallback rules but they will need additional QA cycles (approx +3 days) and a small change to the rollout plan.

Action requested from execs: either approve the 2-week soft exception for the autoscaler migration (to allow the routing + QA window) or tell us to proceed with the accelerated QA plan (which will incur higher ops cost and higher risk during the first 48 hours post-rollout).

I've noted this in the tracker (Row 2: Routing). Quoted below for context:

On Wed, 12 May 2027 at 15:05, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — following today's cross-functional sync I pulled together a lightweight action scrub and a one-page risk thermometer for the QBR....

Karthik
Head, Product Ops
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Natalie Baird <natalie.baird@acmehealth.com>, Satori Integrations <integrations@satori.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: XFN action scrub + QBR risk thermometer

Thanks for the pull, Sean and team. I agree to a provisional 2-week soft exception on the autoscaler migration provided we publish clear SLO tradeoffs and the mitigation plan in the tracker by EOD Monday.

Please do the following:
- Vivek: add the projected latency P50/P95 impact across the affected EU routes and an updated rollback playbook (include monitoring thresholds).
- Marissa: finalize the cost delta and mark whether this requires a pricing notice (if yes, loop in finance).
- Karthik: finalize the QA timeline and confirm if the +3 days are calendar or business days.

I'll mark my decision in the tracker and escalate if anything changes. Natalie — thanks for being on the thread; we'll share the mitigation notes you can present to Acme's platform team.

Lauren
VP Product
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Natalie Baird <natalie.baird@acmehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: XFN action scrub + QBR risk thermometer

Ack — will post numbers and the rollback playbook into the tracker this morning. Preliminary notes:
- Expected P50 change: +12ms on EU edge; P95: +85ms during initial ramp (first 24–48h).
- Monitoring: synthetic checks at 1m cadence, error-rate increase alert at +1.5x baseline, autopage threshold set at 2.5x.
- Rollback: immediate traffic shift to baseline model pool + metric-based canary validation (5m).

I'll also add a short runbook link in the tracker and flag any gaps.

Vivek
Director, Infrastructure Reliability
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: XFN action scrub + QBR risk thermometer — concise recap

Recap / next steps (final):
- Lauren: provisional approval for 2-week soft exception (marked in tracker).
- Vivek: add SLO delta numbers + rollback playbook (Vivek to post by 11:00 PT).
- Marissa: finalize quantization delta and confirm compute window (Marissa to post by EOD Mon).
- Karthik: confirm QA days (Karthik to post Monday AM), and update routing row with exact QA tasks.
- Natalie/Acme: we will share the mitigation notes once Vivek posts the runbook; expected delivery Tue 5/18.

I'll fold this into the QBR prep doc and send a one-slide summary to Execs by Tuesday. If anyone hits a blocker, flag the tracker and ping me directly.

Attachments referenced: xfn_action_tracker.xlsx (updated), qbr_risk_thermometer.pdf
